artDirection: Soft plush rabbit community helpers in a pastel storybook town. Distinct morning street, peach toy clinic and blue-hour plaza. Shared full-body feet anchor, no frightening medical or traffic imagery.

records.name: street
records.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production background for a preschool 2D voice adventure, 16:9 landscape, ideally 1600x900. A cheerful magical small-town bus stop in soft golden morning light. Rounded pastel turquoise and butter-yellow townhouses, a cozy bus-stop shelter at the far left, low flower beds, gently curving sidewalk and a broad clear road in the lower foreground. A small zebra crossing is visible on the right, but no vehicles or people. Painterly storybook illustration with soft plush-like 3D shapes, rich but gentle colors, warm realistic light, rounded silhouettes, suitable for a three-year-old. Camera straight-on at a slightly raised stage view, no extreme perspective. Clear unobstructed foreground floor at about 78% canvas height; leave most of center/right foreground and left foreground empty for runtime characters and a moving bus. Concentrate decorative architecture in the upper third and far edges. This is an outdoor urban street, distinctly different from forests or palace rooms. No letters, signage text, labels, UI, watermark, borders, characters, bus, giant foreground props, weapons or danger. Draw one finished landscape, not a collage.

records.name: clinic
records.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one 16:9 landscape production background, ideally 1600x900, for a three-year-old's magical town voice adventure. A friendly toy clinic interior, distinct from any street or forest: curved peach walls, tall arched windows with soft daylight, mint-green trim, a small rounded reception nook far left, low wall shelves with plush blankets and heart-shaped cushions, a lavender sofa far back right. A gentle childlike medical setting, no hospital machinery. Warm pastel peach, rose and mint palette, polished painterly storybook/soft 3D illustration, detailed but calm materials. Straight-on slightly raised theatrical view. Large EMPTY floor occupying the lower half, floor at 78% image height for runtime rabbit helpers and Elsa. Right-center foreground is open for a large toy tooth and teddy. Decorations concentrated at rear/edges. No people, animals, text, UI, needles, syringes, wounds, blood, drills, scary teeth, logos or red cross symbols. Do not draw the main teddy, tooth or helpers into the scenery. Rounded, welcoming, cozy, no collage or frame.

records.name: plaza
records.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One 16:9 landscape production game background, ideally 1600x900. A magical little town's spacious lakeside community plaza at blue hour, a gentle celebratory evening for preschoolers. Warm amber paper lanterns strung between rounded pastel shopfronts at far left and far right, distant small-town rooftops, a lake glimmering far back center, deep violet and indigo sky, softly glowing windows, low planters at far edges. A wide EMPTY warm stone plaza across the entire lower foreground for runtime rabbit helpers, Elsa, a moving little bus and a big flower. Soft polished painterly storybook/3D cartoon feel, rounded welcoming architecture, gentle rich color and no harsh flashing. Straight-on slightly raised stage view, characters' floor near 78% image height. This is an open urban evening plaza, not a forest campsite, bedroom or street. No characters, vehicles, giant foreground props, text, signs, UI, borders, watermark, fireworks or danger. One cohesive completed landscape.

records.name: helpers
records.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent 2D game sprite atlas, 3 columns by 2 rows, landscape 1536x1024. The reference image establishes the plush baby-rabbit illustration style and friendly facial proportions, NOT its outfit. Create six DIFFERENT friendly rabbit community helpers as full-body isolated sprites, one sprite per cell, same camera straight-on mild three-quarter facing viewer, standing idle with arms relaxed. Big soft ears, warm smiles, large readable eyes, short round bodies, no sharp details. Row 1 left: cream rabbit BUS DRIVER, teal driver cap and navy jacket. Row 1 center: ginger rabbit FIREFIGHTER, rounded orange helmet and navy suit with yellow reflective stripes. Row 1 right: gray rabbit POLICE OFFICER, sky-blue peaked cap and light-blue uniform with small gold STAR badge. Row 2 left: white rabbit DOCTOR, white coat, mint tunic, soft lilac stethoscope hanging around neck. Row 2 center: cream rabbit NURSE, rosy pink tunic and white heart headband. Row 2 right: beige rabbit DENTIST, mint tunic, small round examination mirror on headband, friendly open mouth smile. Preserve each helper's identity and distinct uniform. Each sprite fits inside its 512x512 cell, feet approximately 490 pixels down the cell, ears and hats safely inside with 25px margins. All sprites same perceived scale and shared feet baseline. Real fully transparent background, no cell lines, no scenery, no writing, no labels, no watermark, no detached accessories, no handheld props, no floor shadows. No weapons, handcuffs, needles, syringes, sharp dental tools, masks obscuring smiles. One atlas with exactly six separate complete silhouettes, large clean gaps.
